data: All inputs and numeric values are synthetic. No real bank or customer material was read, changed or sent to external services.
execution: Three independent fresh-context model agents executed user requests using the read-only candidate skill. Normal host model calls were used; no separate external API or network transfer was invoked.
sequential_inputs: S2 second turn was created only after actual first response. I1 second and third turns were each created after the preceding actual response; prior prompts and responses are included in the corresponding input files.
context_limits: Execution agents were not given acceptance_plan.json, other groups outputs, expected prose or evaluation scores. Full user prompts, relevant skill snapshots and model-authored responses/actions are preserved; framework/system internals and private reasoning are not exported.
model_identity: No explicit backend model override was set. Runtime labels describe Codex based on GPT-6; exact backend model/snapshot IDs are not independently exposed. Do not claim verified Astra execution.

platforms.imitation_optional_counts: Python 3.9.6 standard library; no target skill interpreter dependency
platforms.Linux: not run; no available container runtime/execution tool

comparison: No previous-version model execution was run for this feature batch. Baseline is retained for source inspection only; no comparative quality improvement is claimed.
independent_review: Single-candidate de-identified review packet; reader receives real user request and actual response but no version/skill/rules/expected answers. Not an A/B blind comparison.
